comment: The dots enter the solid trace at Q, obscuring the Run 10 crest.
The shallow dash can be followed under the dot at (1890,1911) and across the crossing to (1949,1908).
The long dash reaches the grid edge at (2071,1903). The short dash comes out below the solid line and ends at (2135,1916).
Q is on the descending stroke. The clearer flattening is near (1908,1913).
Q lies in the merged rise beside the left frame, where the Run 10 dots cannot be isolated.
Q is on the last distinct dot, before the grid intersection.
P is the tip of a later, separate dash. At Q the early rise merges with the dots and the left frame, masking the start.
The shallow dash runs straight through Q. The slope change falls across the preceding break in the ink.
The last square is on the separate shallow dash. Earlier squares lie among the merged strokes and dots, where individual dashes cannot all be followed.
The solid diagonal reaches the bottom frame near v=3269. Both squares are within 2 px of its visible ink.
Q lies on the diagonal row of dots. The turn is near (2065,2593).
P is inside the bottom frame, about 8 px below its upper edge. The dots merge into the origin before P.
The oblique dash continues straight beside Q. The horizontal stroke at the dash tip is the grid line.
The visible dashes run above the marked row. The three circles sit on the bottom frame or below the visible edge of the dash.
Q is about 8 px inside the bottom frame at the origin, past the visible end of the solid stroke.
